## Checklist

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, API keys, passwords, or private URLs added anywhere
      (code, tests, docs, fixtures, screenshots, commit messages).
- [ ] No real user data / PII added.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build`, and `npm test` pass.
- [ ] `.env.example` updated if new environment variables were introduced.
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior or setup changed.
- [ ] Change respects the authorized-use and server-side safety model
      (`SECURITY.md`): no path that starts a test bypasses `runPreflight`.
